provenance.note: Legacy deck part 2. The save leaves these nicknames empty; the code is read from the card.

faces.transcription:
STOP

Draw this card just before you set up your first game in August.

MISSION BRIEFING

"The Soviets are holding more trials and building upon their surveillance network.

We've also found the location of Sabik's primary base of operations. You'll be given a Soviet alias to infiltrate it. Find out what he's hiding, and apprehend him if possible."

OPEN 0002 and read its contents.
